title: RefinementPlan
description: Produced by the Meta-Critic during meta-review. Categorized friction, direct (LOW) actions, MEDIUM plan items requiring human approval, and HIGH escalations.

direct_actions.description: LOW-cascade items applied directly during the meta-review.

plan_items.description: MEDIUM-cascade items requiring human approval before enactment. Includes prompt revisions, methodology adjustments, slice-convention changes, new concepts/ entries, role-granularity shifts, and MCP server service changes.

escalations.description: HIGH-cascade items the Meta-Critic surfaces but does not propose changes for. Layer-count/semantics changes, L4 calculus revisions, core process-model changes, introduction of a new agent role.

skill_pass.description: Mandatory skill-pass entry. Added meta-19 per user directive +60% priority on skill propose/modify/split. Every meta-review's plan MUST include this field — either with at least one non-empty action OR with a `no_candidates_reason` explaining why this window produced no skill actions. An empty skill_pass without no_candidates_reason is a discipline failure (the consideration step was skipped).

propose.description: New skill proposals. Each entry: skill name, rationale, and an inline SKILL.md skeleton (frontmatter + 2-4 sentences of body).

modify.description: Modifications to existing skills (output contract sharpening, trigger condition adjustment, new edge case, cross-reference update).

cascade.description: Per the +60% priority calculus: prompt-wording polish is LOW; procedure change or output-contract sharpening is MEDIUM.

split.description: Splits of an existing skill into ≥2 child skills when the body has grown to cover divergent sub-procedures.

no_candidates_reason.description: Required when propose+modify+split are all empty. Names why this window produced no skill actions (e.g., 'no procedural patterns surfaced; window dominated by tooling fixes').
